import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive customer segmentation analysis
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Calculate total spending per customer
df['TotalSpending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                       df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# Calculate age
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']

# Calculate total children
df['TotalChildren'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']

# 1. Income vs Total Spending by Education Level
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
for education in df['Education'].dropna().unique():
    subset = df[df['Education'] == education]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Income'], subset['TotalSpending'], alpha=0.5, label=education, s=30)
ax1.set_xlabel('Income', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Education', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Spending Distribution by Product Category
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                       'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_totals = [df[cat].sum() for cat in spending_categories]
categories_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(categories_labels))
ax2.pie(spending_totals, labels=categories_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Spending Distribution by Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Age Distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
ax3.hist(df['Age'].dropna(), bins=30, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Total Spending by Number of Children
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
spending_by_children = df.groupby('TotalChildren')['TotalSpending'].mean().sort_index()
ax4.bar(spending_by_children.index, spending_by_children.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Number of Children', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Average Spending by Number of Children', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Purchase Channel Comparison
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
channel_labels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals']
channel_means = [df[ch].mean() for ch in channels]
bars = ax5.barh(channel_labels, channel_means, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#FFA07A'], 
                edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Average Number of Purchases', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Purchase Channel Comparison', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, v in enumerate(channel_means):
    ax5.text(v + 0.1, i, f'{v:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 6. Income Distribution by Marital Status
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
marital_statuses = df['Marital_Status'].dropna().unique()
income_data = [df[df['Marital_Status'] == status]['Income'].dropna() for status in marital_statuses]
bp = ax6.boxplot(income_data, labels=marital_statuses, patch_artist=True, showfliers=False)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], sns.color_palette('Set2', len(marital_statuses))):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Income', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Income Distribution by Marital Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=8)
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
